title: gymnadenia conopsea var. pyrenaica
intro: Gymnadenia conopsea var. pyrenaica, commonly known as the Pyrenean autumn gentian, is a variety of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The Pyrenean autumn gentian is also valued for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of indigestion and bloating. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
